The dopamine and noradrenaline supply chain
, what trials and registries can and cannot tell us, and how to plan for gaps, restarts and product changes.
— ADHD medicines influence catecholamine signalling through different transporters and receptors. Their mechanisms, timing and clinical evidence need separate comparison.

— Re-titrating cautiously is usually reasonable. Changing to a medicine that has already been tried and found inadequate is a different decision, and needs reasons.
When medication feels weak, inconsistent or inert
— Check the exact product, delivery, timing and function before drawing a conclusion. A repeated difference deserves review; its cause is a separate question.
— Precursor supply, reuptake inhibition, transmitter release and receptor activation are different interventions. Compare the indication and evidence as well as the mechanism.
